section_note: The five biggest things happening across the Valley this week.

events.title: 26th Annual Salute to Freedom Celebration
events.venue: Brownsville Sports Park, 1000 Sports Park Blvd
events.blurb: Stars, stripes and summer nights — live music, a classic car show, food vendors, and a drone-light + fireworks finale. Veterans get complimentary food and refreshments.

events.title: Freedom Fest
events.venue: Lon C. Hill Destination Park, 1216 Fair Park Blvd
events.blurb: Live music, a beer garden, family games, food vendors, the first-ever Freedom Fest 4K race, and a fireworks show to close out the night.

events.title: Show in the Sky 2026
events.venue: Payne Arena grounds · McAllen Food Park
events.blurb: McAllen's Independence Day tradition — catch the Midnight Mustang Band at the Food Park at 6, then look up for the big show over Payne Arena.

events.title: Annual Walking Beach Parade
events.blurb: Decorate your crew in red, white and blue and stroll the sand — SPI's most laid-back Fourth tradition, right on the Gulf.

events.title: Stars & Stripes Freedom Festival
events.blurb: A free, family-friendly downtown block party capped by a drone show finale lighting up the Mid-Valley sky.

also_happening: Also this week: Mercedes celebrates America's 250th birthday Friday, July 3 at the Mercedes Dome (1202 N. Vermont Ave).
